description: Exactly one value per (company, line item, period).
dim_company.company_key, dim_concept.concept_code, dim_period.period_key and map_xbrl_tag.tag are unique.
Fact keys/values, company identifiers and fiscal years on one-year periods are never null.
Every fact row points at an existing company, concept and period.
Each (company, fiscal_year) maps to a single fiscal-year end date (catches fiscal-calendar bugs).
Every company in dim_company has an MA business address in SEC submissions data.
Reported Assets equals reported LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity (within 0.1%) at every balance-sheet date.
Assets = Liabilities + total equity (incl. noncontrolling interests) + mezzanine equity, within 0.5%, at every balance-sheet date where Liabilities is reported.
Annual revenue is strictly positive for every company-year that has revenue.
Flags annual values that moved more than 5x (up or down) vs the prior fiscal year. Not always wrong - each needs a look.

check: Fiscal-year label matches the filing's own fy
description: For each 10-K, the warehouse's fiscal_year for the filing's own period equals the fy the filer tagged (DocumentFiscalYearFocus).
Same company-year reports both Revenues and an ASC 606 revenue tag that differ by more than 1% (tag priority decides which one is used).

check: Gross profit = revenue - cost of revenue
description: Where all three are reported, reported gross profit matches revenue minus cost of revenue within 1%.

check: Core line items present in latest fiscal year
description: Lists core line items missing for each company's latest fiscal year (core set depends on company type). Full matrix: output/tables/coverage_latest_fy.csv.
Each company's latest fiscal-year end is within 15 months of the run date (a stale company would distort "latest year" comparisons).

check: Capex reported as a positive outflow
description: PaymentsToAcquire* tags are defined as positive numbers; a negative value means a sign error by the filer.

check: DuPont components multiply back to ROE
description: For non-financials, net margin x asset turnover x equity multiplier equals ROE (to 1e-9). Guards the analytics layer against denominator mismatches.
